name: After § 3
title: REPORT on the future of agriculture and the post-2027 common agricultural policy
part_text: 3a. Stresses that European farmers, regardless of their region, comply with the same rules under the CAP, including environmental and climate requirements, while competing on the same single market; calls, therefore, for both external and internal convergence of direct payments across the EU, in order to ensure that farmers in all Member States receive equal support and can compete under fair and balanced conditions, while strengthening regional cohesion and fair competition;
